date_note: Date of the Teletica article reporting the company's denial; the page gives no earlier day for the company's statement. The original claim was made in September, per the article.
exec: Costa Rican firm Cero Riesgo denies mass data extraction; the data claim is unverified.
plain: A user said in September they hold data taken from Cero Riesgo. The company says its preliminary forensic results do not support a mass data theft.
summary: Teletica reports that a user with the handle Jarol1488 said in September they held "400 millones de líneas de datos" from Cero Riesgo. The company says preliminary forensic results do not support a mass extraction and that the leaked documents differ from its records. Teletica says the investigation kept the company's servers offline for several days.
title: Costa Rican firm Cero Riesgo denies mass data extraction after dark-web claim

validation.note: Single publisher (Teletica); attacker's claim, company denies mass extraction.
